TRY: Create a CSS rule

Cascading Style Sheets, CSS, gives color and layout to web elements based on some chosen characteristic of that element. Without applying css, website pages will look like a text document.

  1. Selector
  2. Attribute
  3. Value
  4. Psuedo-class

#CSS

 {

background-color

:

limegreen

;
}


#CSS

:hover

 {

background-color

:

hsl(120, 61%, 45%)

;
}

The above example is a one-line, one-attribute css id rule. The same style gives this element the green background color.

Style sheets can compose thousands of rules of varying complexity. Rules and/or style sheets can repeat throughout a website easily. Multiple css files can be added (or not added) to as part of the layout.
